description: This file contains security utilities for password hashing and JWT token generation. It provides functions to hash passwords, verify passwords, and create JWT tokens with configurable expiration and secret settings, including environment variable handling.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,int] _jwt_settings()
methods.description: Loads JWT configuration from environment variables, with fallback for development environment if JWT_SECRET is not set.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with optional extra claims.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
